predecessors.name: Huns
predecessors.text: 'the Middle Alföld between the Middle Danube and the Tisza rivers': the Danube-Tisza interfluve of Hungary

successors.name: Ostrogoths
successors.text: 'the Middle Alföld between the Middle Danube and the Tisza rivers': the Danube-Tisza interfluve of Hungary

ledger.x: 454: Edeko founds a Scirian kingdom in the Alföld.
468: the Sciri are crushed at Bolia and the Ostrogoths take their land.

wars.name: Battle of Nedao
wars.outcome: The Gepid-led Germanic coalition defeats the Huns under Ellac; 'Hunnic dominance in Central and Eastern Europe was broken' and the Gepids, Rugii, Heruli, Suebi and the others became independent by the early 460s.

wars.name: Battle of Bolia
wars.outcome: Ostrogothic victory 'achieving supremacy in Pannonia'; 'the battle marked the end of the Sciri as a separate people' and the Ostrogoths 'gained control of territory of the Sciri'.

certainty.note: The page gives the kingdom's position only as 'between the Middle Danube and the Tisza rivers'; no boundary.
